title: No test presses a button in the sales demo and checks what happens
what: The demo gym pretends to answer about twenty actions (reply to a question, reply or close a member message, take back a message, save reminders, add or fix measurements, save or withdraw a diet plan, book or cancel training, save timings, pick a trainer, approve a request). The demo tests only open each page. Only two actions are checked, and only behind the screen: marking an order ready and sending a message.
expected: Each action the demo acts out is pressed on the demo screen at least once and the result the visitor sees is checked.
who: owner on a gym sales visit
how_often: every demo given after a change
fix_line: Add one demo test per acted-out action that presses it and checks the words and list on screen

title: The demo's "this does nothing here" message is never checked on screen
what: When a visitor presses something the demo does not act out, the page should say "This is the demo gym, so this does nothing here. It works in your own gym." No test checks these words appear. One test checks only that the hidden code is right for saving a product. A raw code, a silent nothing or a fake success would pass.
expected: At least one refused action per demo page is pressed and the plain demo sentence is checked on screen, with no raw code and no success message.
how_often: every demo tap on a switched-off action
fix_line: Press one refused action per demo page in a test and check the demo sentence shows

title: The front desk demo test only opens five pages
what: The front desk kind of the demo is tested by opening Today, Members, Enquiries, Shop, Member messages and More. It never checks that the signed-in person is the desk person, that the desk menu has its own "Workout offer" line, or any desk limit on screen (staff list, training progress, questions, reminders, challenges, timings), or that a desk answer carries the desk person's name.
expected: The desk demo test checks the desk person's name, the desk menu, and one owner-only refusal on screen.
who: gym owners shown the front desk view
fix_line: Extend the desk demo test to check the desk name, menu and refusals

title: Nothing checks that a reload undoes changes made through the demo's pretend server
what: The reload test adds one member and checks it is gone. Changes held by the pretend server (an answered question, a cancelled order, removed timings, a decided request) are never made and then checked as reset after a reload.
expected: One test makes a pretend-server change, reloads, and checks the sample gym is back as at the start.
fix_line: Add a reload check after one pretend-server change

title: Two privacy promises on the panel are never checked by any test
what: Training progress tells owners "Body weight, photos and notes are never shared", and Member messages says messages are deleted 180 days after the last one. No test, demo or real gym, checks either sentence is shown, or that body weight or photos never appear in Training progress.
expected: A test checks both sentences show and that no body weight, photo or note appears on the Training progress page.
fix_line: Assert both sentences and the absence of body data on the Training progress screen

title: The demo's menu badges and Today counts are never compared with the waiting cards
what: The demo shows badges for Member questions and Member messages and a line on Today. No test checks that these numbers match the cards waiting, or that they fall after a reply. A known fault of this kind already exists for the front desk.
expected: The demo test reads each badge and Today count and checks it equals the waiting cards, before and after one reply.
who: gym owners on a sales visit
fix_line: Compare each demo badge with the waiting cards in the demo test

title: "Back to my gym" is never pressed in a test
what: The test checks the button links to the home address, but never presses it to see the real gym open, still signed in, with no sample members in it.
expected: A test presses "Back to my gym" and checks the real gym opens signed in, without demo data.
who: gym owners who try the demo on their own device
how_often: each time the demo is left
fix_line: Press the button in the existing demo test and check the real gym
